facts.fact: Loi n° 42-2025 of 31 December 2025 (2026 finance law) appropriates FCFA 30,139,589,283 for Code 45, programme 118 Poste, télécommunication et économie numérique, funded from domestic revenue; the bill had FCFA 30,079,589,283.
facts.system: Programme 118 Poste, télécommunication et économie numérique, 2026

facts.fact: The record gives the programme at FCFA 23,093,583,163 for 2025 and FCFA 30,139,589,283 for 2026, a rise of 30.5%, against 3.9% for the whole general budget.
facts.system: Programme 118 Poste, télécommunication et économie numérique, 2025 to 2026
